text: Lesson 133 Sensational
news!
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
What reasons did Karen Marsh give for wanting to retire?
zh: 卡伦·马什想退休的原因是什么？
zh_hant: 卡倫·馬什想退休的原因是什麼？

text: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
zh: 马什小姐，你刚拍完一部新电影吗？
zh_hant: 馬什小姐，你剛拍完一部新電影嗎？

text: Yes, I have.
Are you going to make another?
No, I'm not.
I'm going to retire.
I feel very tired.
I don't want to make another film for a long time.
zh: 我很久都不想再拍电影了。
zh_hant: 我很久都不想再拍電影了。

text: Let's buy a newspaper, Liz.
zh: 莉兹，我们去买份报纸吧。
zh_hant: 莉茲，我們去買份報紙吧。

text: Listen to this!
'Karen Marsh:
Sensational News!
By our reporter, Alan Jones.
zh: 由我们的记者艾伦·琼斯报道。
zh_hant: 由我們的記者艾倫·瓊斯報道。

text: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
zh: 卡伦·马什今天抵达伦敦机场。
zh_hant: 卡倫·馬什今天抵達倫敦機場。

text: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
zh: 她穿着蓝色连衣裙和貂皮大衣。
zh_hant: 她穿著藍色連衣裙和貂皮大衣。

text: She told me she had just made a new film.
zh: 她告诉我她刚拍完一部新电影。
zh_hant: 她告訴我她剛拍完一部新電影。

text: she said she was not going to make another.
zh: 她说她不打算再拍另一部了。
zh_hant: 她說她不打算再拍另一部了。

text: She said she was going to retire.
She told reporters she felt very tired
zh: 她告诉记者们她觉得非常累，
zh_hant: 她告訴記者們她覺得非常累，

text: and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
zh: 而且很久都不想再拍电影了。'
zh_hant: 而且很久都不想再拍電影了。'

text: I wonder why!
